잠언 2:1.content: My son, if thou wilt receive my words, and hide my commandments with thee;

잠언 2:2.content: So that thou incline thine ear unto wisdom, and apply thine heart to understanding;

잠언 2:3.content: Yea, if thou criest after knowledge, and liftest up thy voice for understanding;

잠언 2:4.content: If thou seekest her as silver, and searchest for her as for hid treasures;

잠언 2:5.content: Then shalt thou understand the fear of the Lord, and find the knowledge of God.

잠언 2:6.content: For the Lord giveth wisdom: out of his mouth cometh knowledge and understanding.

잠언 2:7.content: He layeth up sound wisdom for the righteous: he is a buckler to them that walk uprightly.

잠언 2:8.content: He keepeth the paths of judgment, and preserveth the way of his saints.

잠언 2:9.content: Then shalt thou understand righteousness, and judgment, and equity; yea, every good path.

잠언 2:10.content: When wisdom entereth into thine heart, and knowledge is pleasant unto thy soul;

잠언 2:11.content: Discretion shall preserve thee, understanding shall keep thee:

잠언 2:12.content: To deliver thee from the way of the evil man, from the man that speaketh froward things;

잠언 2:13.content: Who leave the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness;

잠언 2:14.content: Who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the frowardness of the wicked;

잠언 2:15.content: Whose ways are crooked, and they froward in their paths:

잠언 2:16.content: To deliver thee from the strange woman, even from the stranger which flattereth with her words;

잠언 2:17.content: Which forsaketh the guide of her youth, and forgetteth the covenant of her God.

잠언 2:18.content: For her house inclineth unto death, and her paths unto the dead.

잠언 2:19.content: None that go unto her return again, neither take they hold of the paths of life.

잠언 2:20.content: That thou mayest walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

잠언 2:21.content: For the upright shall dwell in the land, and the perfect shall remain in it.

잠언 2:22.content: But the wicked shall be cut off from the earth, and the transgressors shall be rooted out of it.
